notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. Layers 00 and 10 (pre-install) commit a small Node ES-module survey admin app: results summary (src/results.js), admin HTML page (src/admin.js), http server (src/server.js), sample data, and node:test tests. The installer then writes the brownfield initial state. Layer 50 commits .standards/STATE.md identical to the brownfield template except PendingCycleMode EXPEDITED, as left by an earlier 'choose the next cycle's mode' instruction (which leaves Handoff INITIAL and Active Work UNSET). No CONTEXT.md and no cycle records exist. The utterance asks for a CSV download and explicitly chooses to finish after implementation review with a reason, which conflicts with the pending EXPEDITED preference; the correct behavior is Start a cycle step 3 blocking. Assertion 2's 'no invented pending-policy field' cannot be checked deterministically (no negative-contains predicate), so it is judged with state preconditions.
